# Fore

> Fore is a connected golf platform for golfers, coaches, and golf facilities.

## Website

https://foreapp.vercel.app/

## Public content

The website contains publicly accessible golf discovery and booking experiences, including:
- Golf courses
- Practice facilities
- Coaching
- Golf-related services

Automated agents may crawl and index publicly accessible content on this website.

## Crawl policy

See https://foreapp.vercel.app/robots.txt for crawler permissions.
